description.value: Driftwood Marine Regional Park is a nature reserve in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island, managed by the Comox Valley Regional District. Its marine setting along Baynes Sound offers coastal scenery that touring cyclists passing through the area may enjoy as a rest stop or side trip.
